description_en: The three-tiered temple in Om Bāhāḥ was built by Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhāro in 1697. A gildedtoraṇashowing an image of Nṛtyeśvara flanked by Gaṇeśa to his right and Kumāra to his left surmounts the main entrance of the temple. A woodentoraṇaresembling thetoraṇaof the main door is fixed above the lattice woodwork on the western side. The first roof is covered withjhĩgaṭītiles whilst the upper two roofs are layered with flat metal sheets. Carved struts support all three roofs. On top of the temple, a gilded pinnacle is topped with a parasol and flanked by two metal flags. Inside the sanctum, one can find a stone Gaṇeśa statue alongside aniconic stone statues which are worshipped as Mahādeva and Pārvatī.This temple was reconstructed in 2011. The local Śreṣṭha community handles theguthi. The temple has acapāḥ;this can be found to its west.
description_ne: यस गणेशलाई ‘सेतो गणेश’, ‘स्वय्त गणेश’का साथै ‘तुयुम्ह गणेद्यः’ भनिएका अभिलेख पाइन्छन् । गर्भगृहभित्रको गणेश मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि हाल भएको मूर्ति वि.सं. २०६८ मा पुनःस्थापित नक्कल प्रति हो । गणेश मूर्तिको दायाँ–बाँया भएका दुई अमूर्त ढुङ्गालाई स्थानीयले महादेव र पार्वती मान्दै पूज्दै आएका छन् । यसरी मन्दिर भित्र गणेशका साथै महादेव र पार्वती पनि भएबाट गणेश मन्दिर अगाडि साँढेको प्रतिमाका साथै त्रिशूल र सिंह स्तम्भ पनि खडा गरिएको पाउछौं ।मन्दिरमा भएको शिलापत्र अनुसार यस तीन तले मन्दिरको निर्माण रामकृष्ण भारोले ने.सं. ८१७ मा गरेका थिए । मन्दिरका अनेक टुँडालमध्ये एकमा ने.सं. ८३५ को अभिलेख छ । मन्दिर निर्माणको १८ वर्षपछि टुँडाल चढाइएको उल्लेख पाइएबाट उक्त सालमा मन्दिर जीर्णोद्धार भएको अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । मन्दिरको पछिल्लो जीर्णोद्धार वि.सं. २०६९मा भएको थियो ।यस मन्दिरसंग सम्बन्धित गुठी अस्तित्वमा छ जसमा श्रेष्ठ समुदायको आवद्धता रहेको छ । वर्षवर्धन पूजा लगायत वर्षभर विभिन्न धार्मिक–सांस्कृतिक कार्य सम्पन्न गर्दै आएको उक्त निजी गुठीमा केही जग्गाको आयस्ता पनि भएको भनाई गुठीयारहरूको छ । यस गणेशसंग सम्बन्धित चपाः मन्दिरसंगै पश्चिममा बनेको छ । यसै गणेश गुठीले उक्त चपाः भोगचलन गर्दै आएको छ । चपाःको भूमि तल्लाम भएको फल्चामा यस गणेशको नाममा प्रत्येक मंगलबार भजन गायन हुँदै आएको छ ।
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)
references: Sources and references Sources Inscription from VS 1988 Details श्री गणेसाय नम १. सम्वत १९८८ साल आशु– २. न ८ गते रोज ५ स्यांमलाल ३. बुधीलाल थ्वते समोहन दूता ४. जुल सुभं ।।

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a brass eaves board (B)
historical_events.event_description: Syāmalāla donated the brass eaves board to cover the middle roof.

One of the struts of the temple was donated in 1715, 18 years after the initial construction of the temple. It is possible that the temple was repaired on this date. The donor’s name could not be deciphered.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a brass eaves board (A)
historical_events.event_description: Lakṣmīkumārī donated funds to cover the brass eaves board on the upper roof.

In VS 2066 (2009), the renovation process began after the performance of akṣamāpūjā.The second tiled roof was replaced with a brass-plated one. The new stone statue of Gaṇeśa was installed in the sanctum on the 29th day of Kārtika in VS 2068 (2011).

historical_events.event_name: Donation of brass tympanum and door
historical_events.event_description: The brass door and tympanum were donated to the temple.
The temple was renovated and the brass eaves board was placed in the upper roof.
The main stone statue of Gaṇeśa was stolen.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of a brass eaves board (C)
historical_events.event_description: Candramāna and his wife Dilkumārī donated a brass eaves board (jhalara) for the lower roof.

Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhāro constructed the temple. Aguthiwas also established to manage the temple. The inscription mentions that theguthiis responsible for maintaining the temple courtyard as well as thephalcāon the right-hand side.
